messages:
melissa: Quick sync — RootsScale customer snapshot is almost ready. Need: final interview window, approved quote to use in the launch post, and legal signoff on one short quote for press. Doc here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1RootsScaleCase (working draft). Can people flag availability and turnaround times? :calendar:

alejandro: I can run the interview (30m). Available Tue/Wed mornings PT. I’ll pull a short quote from the call and drop in the doc. Do we want to tie this into the benchmark narrative/webinar we mentioned last week?

sarah: RootsScale team ok with Tue 10am PT. They asked if we can share a suggested quote in advance so their CEO can prep. Also: they want the case to mention throughput improvements >40% — is that fine to include?

melissa: Yes to Tuesday 10. Alejandro, paste the proposed quote snippet into the doc and mark as "for approval". Sarah — the throughput stat comes from our CI harness, but jordan-legal needs to clear any specific performance claims before we publish.

jordan-legal: @melissa @sarah please paste the exact quote and the phrasing for the throughput claim into the doc. We can usually turn around a quick review within 48 business hours unless it triggers any benchmark/claims escalation. If you include any % numbers, link to the internal benchmark appendix.

alejandro: Pasting proposed quote (draft):
```
"Switching to Redwood reduced inference latency and cut per-request cost — we saw a ~42% throughput improvement in production, which let our team scale the feature without adding new infra."
```
Marked as "for approval" in the doc. I also added a short webinar CTA idea under the "promotion" section — 30 min customer + engineer panel.

jordan-legal: Quick redlines: change "reduced inference latency and cut per-request cost" -> "reduced median inference latency and improved cost per request". For the ~42% claim, add parenthetical: "(internal benchmark, Oct 2025)". Otherwise good to go.

sarah: Customer OK with the wording edits and the parenthetical. They also prefer embargo until demo is live next Thursday (2025-11-12).

melissa: Great — webinar tie-in scheduled for Nov 13. @ops-bot can you book a 30m recording slot with engineering and RootsScale for Nov 6 9am PT and add calendar invites? :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Booking confirmed — Recording: Nov 6 09:00 PT, 30m. Invites sent to melissa, alejandro, sarah, roots-scale-contact@example.com.

melissa: Jordan, if legal can finalize today/tomorrow we’ll route the final quote to PR and sales for inbound lead routing. Alejandro, please pull a tight 2-3 sentence lead for the launch post so we can A/B test headline copy in the campaign.

alejandro: On it — will drop the two headline variants in the doc by EOD. :writing_hand:

melissa: Awesome. Thanks team — small checklist: final legal signoff, customer embargo noted, recording booked, PR + benchmark narrative draft in doc. Ping me if anything slips. :rocket:
